newsitem.title: USA: UAW, Chrysler reach tentative pact.
newsitem.headline: UAW, Chrysler reach tentative pact.

text.p: The United Auto Workers Union and Chrysler Corp said Sunday they reached a tentative agreement on a new labor pact covering 66,000 hourly workers at the U.S. number three automaker.

The deal comes nearly two weeks after the union reached a tentative agreement with Ford Motor Co for 105,000 workers. That deal is a three-year agreement that guarantees employement for 95 percent of Ford's workers.
The two sides held intense negotiations for the last two days and it was uncertain earlier whether an agreement could be reached Sunday.
The previous three-year agreement between the UAW and Detroit's Big Three automakers, which covers nearly 400,000 workers, expired September 14.
The UAW extended the deadline for Chrysler and General Motors Corp. A new deadline has not been set, said Solomon.
The final ratification of the agreement between UAW and Ford Motor is expected to be ratified by all of Ford's UAW locals Sunday.
